title: Plus Annual Loyalty Rate Table for Pals Rewards Insider and VIP Members
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** A Plus Annual loyalty rate is a percentage reduction of the first-term Plus Annual fee when a customer on a free tier buys Tailwise Plus Annual. It is set by the free tier the membership holds and the full calendar months it has been enrolled, counted from its enrollment date.

| Tier held | Months enrolled | Plus Annual loyalty rate |
|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards VIP | 36 or more | 20% (0.2) |
| Pals Rewards VIP | fewer than 36 | 12% (0.12) |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 36 or more | 8% (0.08) |
| any other membership (Pals Rewards Insider under 36 months, Pals Rewards Member) | any | none |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** A Pals Rewards VIP enrolled 36 full months takes 20%; at 35 months, 12%. A Pals Rewards Insider at 36 months takes 8%; at 35 months, none.

**Illustration (hypothetical fee figure).** On a fee figure of $50.00, 20% is $10.00, 12% is $6.00 and 8% is $4.00.
